LanguageData.RavenResearch_DegradationCharm.label: (Raven) Corruption Charmcraft
LanguageData.RavenResearch_DegradationCharm.descripti: Research forbidden talisman techniques that directly affect the minds of others. By combining psychoactive substances with raven bloodline essence, one can craft "Corruption Talismans" that twist the will and amplify desire.
